The chin remains smooth with no glasses, headgear, moustache or beard added, and exactly one restrained closed mouth remains.

entries.positive_observation: The final derivative retains the approved parent RGB art: a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes, one restrained closed mouth, no human skin, nose or ears, and the source's three-quarter composition, source-compatible gaze, shoulder/chest crop and directional modeling. Short gray-brown hair preserves the high receding hairline, side part, swept-back top, close sides and short sideburns, with distinct dark brows and a clean-shaven face. The dark olive-green uniform retains red collar tabs with gold oakleaf embroidery, gold shoulder board/cords, one black-and-white neck cross, a gold breast eagle and the multicolored ribbon bar clipped by the lower crop. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a neck column, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The pale gray-beige painted backing remains fully opaque with its soft mottling and vignette; no frame, note, cutout or halo was added. Full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows complete backing and clothing without holes, smoke or a working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the repaired RGBA for production. Independent read-only verification confirms source-alpha-resize-bilinear-rgb-unchanged-v1, identical parent/derived RGB pixels, and output alpha exactly matching the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. Source and returned extrema are [255,255]; source, resized and output corner arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. The independently recomputed resized-alpha SHA-256 matches the receipt.
